$description: Visa Roads brand tokens. One source for the site (tailwind.config.ts) and the app (Expo theme). Source of truth for values: the Brand Book in Notion. Change here, never in a consumer.
$changelog: 1.1.0 (14 Oct 2026, UX audit): paper fg-muted and fg-faint darkened to pass WCAG AA; added indicator, progress, pressed, disabled, focus, error (proposed), photo-plate roles in both modes; han type roles (proposed); native font-scaling caps, native line-height floors and letter-spacing unit rule; platform touch minimums. Raw palette unchanged.

paper.$description: Page background in paper mode. Warm off-white, never pure white.

ink.$description: Text, rules, buttons. Slightly warm black, never pure black.

acid.$description: The one accent. Highlights, section rules, progress, stamps. Never text on paper (1.03:1).

night.$description: Page background in night mode and the dark product canvas.

logo.$description: The official VisaRoads logo's own colours (Brand Identity files; Pantone 282 C / 7427 C / 117 C). Logo and print only, never UI text, fills or states. Decided 14 Oct 2026: the app UI stays paper / ink / acid, and the app icon is acid on ink.

crimson.$description: Pantone 7427 C. The swoosh on the primary logo.

gold.$description: Pantone 117 C. The swoosh on the website and ink versions.

theme.$description: Semantic roles. The app and the site read these, never the raw palette, so a mode switch is one lookup.
theme.$contrast: WCAG 2.2 relative-luminance ratios, computed 14 Oct 2026 against the mode's bg. Text needs 4.5:1 (3:1 at 24px+ regular or 18.66px+ bold); controls, focus and state indicators need 3:1. Muted and faint are opaque hexes so the ratio does not drift over other surfaces; the rgba they derive from is in each $description.

fg-muted.$description: Ink at 65% over paper. 5.11:1 on bg, 4.54:1 on row-pressed. Any size of text. (Was 60% = 4.36:1, which failed AA for the 11-14px source lines, captions and labels that use it.)

fg-faint.$description: Ink at 52% over paper. 3.42:1 on bg. ONLY large text (24px+, e.g. the italic second line of a display headline) and non-text marks (unearned-badge dashed border). Never body, caption, label or placeholder text. (Was 40% = 2.46:1, which failed even the 3:1 large-text bar.)

rule.$description: 1.35:1. Decorative separators only. Never the only boundary of a control or input; those use border.strong.

accent.$description: 1.03:1 on paper: in paper mode acid is a FILL behind ink text or on an ink surface, never a mark that must be seen on its own against paper.

indicator.$description: Selected tab bar, current level on the ladder, selected segment. Acid fails here in paper mode (1.03:1), which would leave selection carried by text colour alone.

progress-fill.$description: 1.31:1 against the track in paper mode: a progress bar is therefore decorative (hidden from screen readers) and the value is ALWAYS also printed as text ("42 / 100", "Question 3 of 7").

button-bg-pressed.$description: Ink at 85% over paper. button-fg on it 9.99:1. No scale or bounce on press.

row-pressed.$description: Ink at 6% over paper, for list rows, options and chips while pressed. fg 13.56:1, fg-muted 4.54:1 on it. Android may use a ripple of the same colour (borderless: false).

disabled-bg.$description: Ink at 12% over paper. Disabled controls are exempt from contrast, but the label must still say why (helper text), never colour alone.

focus.$description: Keyboard / switch-control focus ring, 2px, 2px offset. 15.26:1 on bg.

error.$description: PROPOSED, needs Brand Book sign-off. 6.63:1 on paper. Form validation and failed network actions ONLY. Never for readiness vocabulary ("not yet" is not an error). Always paired with an icon and text.

photo-plate-bg.$description: Same in both modes: the solid plate behind a caption or back button laid over a photograph.

fg-muted.$description: Paper at 62% over night. 6.72:1 on bg, 5.53:1 on row-pressed.

fg-faint.$description: Paper at 42% over night. 3.72:1 on bg. Same restriction as paper: large text and non-text marks only.

accent.$description: 15.7:1 on night: acid may stand alone as a mark in night mode.

button-bg-pressed.$description: Paper at 85% over night. button-fg on it 11.82:1.

row-pressed.$description: Paper at 8% over night. fg 13.32:1, fg-muted 5.53:1 on it.

error.$description: PROPOSED, needs Brand Book sign-off. 10.87:1 on night. Same usage rules as paper.

font.$description: Per script. A screen picks the family by the active locale's script, never by locale name, so Arabic (ar) and Persian (fa) share one stack.

display.$description: Weight 400 only; italic for the second line of a headline. Covers en, fr.
Weights 700, 900. Self-hosted (SIL OFL). Covers fa, ar.

text.$description: Weights 400, 500, 700. No letter-spacing, no uppercase transforms on this script.

display.$description: Weights 700, 900. Covers zh. Proposed, not yet approved.

type.$description: Sizes in px on the web; the same numbers are pt (iOS) and sp (Android) in the app, so they follow the system text size. Line-height unitless (multiply by the SCALED font size for React Native, which takes absolute values). letterSpacing is in em: React Native takes points, so pass letterSpacing x fontSize. Arabic script takes the larger line-height of each pair. No rendered text below 11 (the sketch's 10px kickers and photo captions move to label/caption). maxScale is the React Native maxFontSizeMultiplier for the role; every role keeps allowFontScaling on, and body-class roles reach at least 2.0 (WCAG 1.4.4). nativeLineHeight, where present, replaces lineHeight in the app: below 1.0 React Native clips ascenders on Android and DM Serif / Estedad glyph tops on iOS.

display-han-l.$description: PROPOSED with the zh faces. Noto Serif SC. Never italic: the Latin italic second line becomes a fg-faint second line in the same upright face.

figure.$description: A single large number: readiness score, funds amount. Display family. Always accompanied by its unit as text and a spoken label ("42 out of 100").

row.$description: List rows, checklist items. Rows grow in height with the text; size.row is a minimum, never a fixed height.

caption.$description: Source lines, disclaimers. Colour fg-muted at most, never fg-faint.

label-latin.$description: Latin script only. Uppercase is a style, not the string: the catalogue holds sentence case so screen readers do not spell it out.

tab-label.$description: Tab bar labels, any script, never uppercase. Capped low because the bar must not grow; iOS users at accessibility sizes get the label via the tab's accessibilityLabel and long-press large-content view where the tab implementation supports it.

touch-min.$description: iOS hit target (HIG 44x44 pt). The visual may be smaller; the hit area may not.

touch-min-android.$description: Android hit target (Material 48x48 dp), with 8dp between adjacent targets. The app uses max(touch-min, touch-min-android) = 48 on both platforms unless a layout cannot fit it.

button.$description: Minimum height; grows with text size.

chip.$description: Visual height of every chip (language, country, programme filters; the sketch's 36px programme chips move to 40). Hit area extended to 48 with hitSlop (4 top, 4 bottom); gap between chips 8.

rule-accent.$description: The acid rule under a heading.

focus-ring.$description: Width and offset of the focus ring, in theme.<mode>.focus.

mark.$description: The app icon and favicon only.

border.$description: Values reference paper mode; in night mode resolve the same role from theme.night (rule, fg, fg-faint).

motion.$description: One curve. Everything off under reduced motion (iOS Reduce Motion and Android Remove animations both arrive through AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled; listen for changes). Under it, transitions become instant or a 150ms cross-fade, the hero zoom and word-by-word headline do not run, and screen transitions follow the system. No bounce, no elastic, nothing scroll-driven that takes the scroll away. Navigation transitions themselves stay native (react-native-screens), not re-timed to this curve.

headline.$description: Masked word-by-word headline, section rule draw.

stagger.$description: Per word in a headline; capped at 500ms total.

elevation.$description: None. The brand uses rules and fills, not shadows.
